baseline_probe.identified_gap: N7.7 requires a durable tenant-scoped enterprise-email lifecycle beyond synchronous/in-process retry: queue, retry scheduling, templates/versioning, provider correlation/tracking and bounce handling.

N7.7.B_DOMAIN.scope: Define tenant-scoped enterprise-email domain contracts for message intent, recipients, template/version reference, delivery lifecycle/status, provider correlation, idempotency/deduplication, tracking and bounce semantics.
invariants: no secret material in domain state

N7.7.C_DB_MIG.scope: Add only the durable persistence required for queued email, templates/versions, attempts/provider correlation, tracking/bounce state and retry scheduling; keep migrations additive/reversible and reuse generic outbox where contract-compatible.

N7.7.D_BACKEND_API.scope: Implement application orchestration and API/adapters for enqueue/query/template administration/rendering and provider tracking/bounce ingestion where applicable.
invariants: secret references only, never secret values

N7.7.E_JOBS_WORKER.scope: Implement durable dispatcher/worker semantics with safe claim/lease, bounded retries/backoff, replay/crash safety and terminal failed/dead-letter disposition.

N7.7.F_FRONTEND_ADMIN.scope: Provide tenant-scoped administration/visibility for templates, queued/delivery states, attempts, tracking and bounces without exposing SMTP/provider secrets.

N7.7.G_TEST_CI.scope: Certify directed unit/integration/contract/E2E/security/migration tests for enqueue/idempotency, tenant isolation, template validation/rendering, retry/backoff, crash replay, tracking/bounce and relevant negative paths; adjust CI only when causally required.

N7.7.H_DOC_CERT.scope: Perform final REVIEW_FIRST and append-only documentation/certification with byte-prefix preservation where TASKS.md/CHANGELOG_AI.md state must change, then emit/re-read LISTO_REAL receipt.
invariants: byte-prefix exact pre-EOF for append-only docs

rollback_strategy: Each material phase must be independently reversible; schema DOWN removes only N7.7 additions, worker/API rollout must preserve the existing direct SMTP service until the durable path is certified, and no deployment/production action is in scope.
